requirement: The genre field must be one of a fixed enumerated list of valid genres; other values are rejected.
label: GAP
reasoning: There is no enumerated list of valid genres anywhere in the code, and no validation logic that checks whether the genre field value belongs to such a list. The POST and PUT handlers only verify that genre is a string (isinstance check), but any string value is accepted. A test submitting an invalid genre value would pass without error, so the requirement is entirely absent.
